## Merge checklist

- [ ] Change is focused and based on current `main`
- [ ] Acceptance criteria are satisfied
- [ ] Tests cover new behavior and relevant failure states
- [ ] `quality` passed
- [ ] `dependency-audit` passed
- [ ] Audit is complete
- [ ] Review is documented and conversations are resolved
- [ ] Documentation is updated
- [ ] Squash merge is appropriate
